# Build — how the site is assembled

`gitguild/index.html` is generated. The hand-written inputs live in
`gitguild/src/`; `tools/build/` turns them into one self-contained file.

## Inputs

| Source | Role in the page |
|---|---|
| `src/template.html` | Page shell: head, sections, panel, footer, and the placeholders below |
| `src/styles.css` | All CSS, inlined into `<style>` |
| `src/projects.js` | All content → `window.GUILD` (collective copy, 12 projects, order, merge train) |
| `src/emblem-geometry.js` | Generated → `window.GUILD_GRID` (viewBox, nodes, traces, adjacency) |
| `src/app.js` | Rendering + interaction, inlined as the last script |
| `design/logo-final.json` | Mark geometry used to emit the SVG symbol and favicon |

`app.js` reads the two globals and renders everything else at runtime: the
emblem (halos, traces, sparks, node rings), the tooltip, the project cards, the
info panel, the merge-train commit graph, nav/reveal behaviour and the copy
button. Nothing else is fetched — there are no external fonts, scripts or
images.

## Placeholders

`template.html` contains `__NAME__` tokens that `build_site.py` replaces:

| Token | Replaced with |
|---|---|
| `__STYLES__`, `__PROJECTS__`, `__GEOMETRY__`, `__APP__` | contents of the matching `src/` file |
| `__MARK_SYMBOL__` | `<symbol id="guild-mark">` built from `logo-final.json` |
| `__VIEW__` | the mark's viewBox |
| `__FAVICON__` | base64 data URI of the favicon SVG |
| `__GITHUB__`, `__CHAT__`, `__MAIL__` | links (constants in `build_site.py`) |
| `__QUICKSTART__` | the copyable CLI command |
| `__LEDE__` | the hero lede, pulled from `projects.js` |

## Scripts (`tools/build/`)

### `build_site.py`

1. Builds the mark body: white/orange path groups plus the twelve node rings.
2. Emits `gitguild/assets/emblem.svg`, `logo-lockup.svg` and `favicon.svg`
   (standalone copies for use outside the page).
3. Inlines styles, projects, geometry and app into `template.html`.
4. Writes `gitguild/index.html`.

```bash
python3 tools/build/build_site.py
```

### `build_geometry.py`

Regenerates `gitguild/src/emblem-geometry.js` from `design/logo-final.json` —
the path-to-node adjacency that drives hover highlighting. Run it after touching
the geometry, then rebuild the site.

```bash
python3 tools/build/build_geometry.py
```

## Outputs

| File | Committed? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `gitguild/index.html` | yes | the deployable page — deliberately committed |
| `gitguild/assets/*.svg` | yes | generated from the same build |
| `gitguild/src/emblem-geometry.js` | yes | generated by `build_geometry.py` |

Because these are generated, edit `src/` and rebuild rather than editing
`index.html`; direct edits work until the next build overwrites them.

Builds are deterministic: paths are resolved from the script location and files
are written with LF endings, so output is identical on Windows and Unix.

## Deploy

The site is one static file with no host-side build:

* **Netlify** — drag `gitguild/` onto app.netlify.com/drop.
* **GitHub Pages / Vercel / Cloudflare Pages / S3** — publish `gitguild/`.

See `gitguild/README.md` for content editing (projects, copy, click behaviour)
and accessibility notes.
